why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Open xyper.market/points . Type the address yourself rather than following links from replies or DMs.
Link and verify your X account. One account per person: "One verified X identity per person. One post or referred person can earn points only once."
Do the starter quests: follow @xypermarket on X, and if you like, confirm the newsletter, start @xyper_bot and join the Telegram chat.
Each week, publish the X quest post (a quote post or a #XyperPoints workflow post) from your verified account.
Optional: open the campaigns page, join a live brief, post on X, submit the post link and wait for the AI score. Approved posts claim a WUNIT0 reward on Unit Zero.
costs: The points quests are free, and the docs say "participating in campaigns is free". Claiming a campaign reward on chain costs gas: "Onchain approval and claiming require a small UNIT0 balance for gas." Xyper's live config shows it sponsors some Unit Zero gas.
